title: Amazing!
body:
This app helps me preform my daily tasks and makes it fun. I get a sense of accomplishment when i “check” my task after finishing it, it motivates you. 
I tried multiple of habit tracker apps but this one is the best for me. 
Customer support is amazing as well. ✨ 5+ stars

Update: i’ve used this app for years now and it’s helped so much! And i will never forget the kindness i got from developer of this app upon my initial download. Truly a person who just wants to help people.
author: Unilia #2739
